channel.title: Newspin: latest timeline updates
channel.description: Newspin turns the biggest ongoing news stories in India, the US and around the world into clear, sourced timelines: what happened, when, and what comes next.

item.title: Delhi air: NCR schools go hybrid; severe air forecast to last
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad move classes up to grade 5 to hybrid mode, and Ghaziabad halts government and private construction until 20 November. The weather office (IMD) expects air to stay 'very poor' to 'severe' until 16 November. Stage III curbs remain; no move to Stage IV had been announced.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Market value falls below $4 trillion
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Nvidia shares fall 2% to close at $162.85, ending the week down about 12%, and its market value closes below $4 trillion. It was worth as much as $5.75 trillion on 5 October. HSBC downgrades the stock to Hold and cuts its price target to $170 from $365, a day after Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400.

item.title: AI this week: ChatGPT agents can now pay for things
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for US Pro users, letting its agents make purchases with card networks' tokens after the user approves each one.

item.title: AI this week: Anthropic IPO reportedly six times oversubscribed
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg News reports demand for Anthropic's shares at about six times the shares on offer, ahead of pricing expected on 18 November.

item.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Wallet and security agents
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its 'dots' AI agents buy things for users, with American Express, Mastercard and Visa. It is limited at first to ChatGPT Pro users aged 18 or over in the US, who approve each purchase with a check such as Face ID; it will not work on sites that block agents. A day earlier, President Greg Brockman showed Daybreak Red Team, in early access, which uses AI agents to test web apps for security holes, and Daybreak Defense Factory, which prepares fixes for engineers to review.

item.title: Anthropic: IPO reportedly six times oversubscribed
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg News reports, citing people familiar with the matter, that the share sale has drawn about six times as many orders as there are shares, and that bankers will favour existing backers, so some buyers may get less than expected. At the top of the range the sale would raise up to $64.4 billion. Demand figures could still change; Anthropic had not commented.

item.title: Outlook outage: Microsoft names a cause and apologises
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · In an updated statement, Microsoft says the incident "was introduced by an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced following a recent network change", and that it was a technical issue not related to cyber attacks or AI agents. It says it is "deeply sorry", reports broad recovery, and says it will give a fuller explanation in a full incident report. Downdetector data showed services hit in 74 countries and territories.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Oil ends a second losing week; IEA sees a surplus
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Brent settles 2 cents higher at $95.84 a barrel after swinging in a $2 range, its second weekly fall in a row. The International Energy Agency (IEA), which advises rich countries on energy, says the oil market will be in surplus this quarter for the first time since the war began, as high prices have cut demand. Iran said four tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz the day before.

item.title: Rupee: Slips to 94.20 on US rate worries
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · The rupee falls 8 paise to close at 94.20 per dollar (provisional). Dealers point to a stronger dollar after higher-than-expected US inflation data, which raised bets that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in December, and to falling Indian shares.

item.title: AI this week: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google's new fast, cheaper model replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash and is rolling out in Search for all users, in the Gemini app and to developers.

item.title: AI model tracker: Google: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google's fast everyday model, replacing Gemini 3.8 Flash; in Search, the Gemini app and the API.

item.title: Google Gemini: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the new everyday model
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cheaper model built for AI agents that replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash as its everyday model. It is rolling out globally in Google Search for all users, in the Gemini app (free users get it through automatic model selection) and to developers at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Google says it finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than 3.8 Flash; these are Google's own figures.

item.title: AI model tracker: Meta: Muse Ember
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · A low-cost model for repetitive agent work, paired with Muse Wonder.

item.title: Meta AI: Muse Ember, a low-cost worker model
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · Meta Superintelligence Lab releases Muse Ember, its lightest and cheapest Muse model, designed to handle repetitive agent tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks and document parsing alongside the larger Muse Wonder. TechCrunch reports a price of 10 cents per million input tokens. Meta says it is cheaper and smarter than Anthropic's Haiku and OpenAI's Luna; no independent tests were reported.

item.title: Delhi air: Air turns 'severe' for the first time this season
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · After 350 on 12 November, Delhi's AQI crosses 400 to reach 403 at 6 am. CPCB data shows 33 of 58 stations in the 'severe' band, with IIT Delhi at 487 and Chandni Chowk and North Campus at 476. Weak winds and smoke from crop fires are blamed. Stage III stays in force.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Huang agrees to appear before Congress
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Huang agrees to appear voluntarily before the relevant House committees, CNN reports. Senators from both parties call the case troubling, and some want Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify too. Nvidia says its product roadmap and customer commitments continue.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Reports: the board pushed him out
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · A person familiar with the matter tells CNBC the board decided to oust Huang after the report of a second alleged affair. Bloomberg, via The Japan Times, reports he will no longer have ties to Nvidia, and that an outside firm is helping find CEO candidates. Rival AMD's shares are up nearly 17% this week.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Lawyers, a chip-smuggling probe and a CEO search
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg reports Huang has hired the law firm Paul Weiss, and that the Justice Department is looking into the woman at the centre of the case over possible links to chip smuggling. Kress keeps her CFO role while the board considers inside and outside candidates. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick will appear before the Senate Banking Committee, and Fortune reports Huang keeps a 3.6% stake.

item.title: AI this week: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is out
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · The founder of the company whose chips power most AI steps down as CEO; reports say the board pushed him out. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO, and Nvidia says its product roadmap continues.

item.title: Outlook outage: A first fix brings some servers back
item.description: ≈ 2:30 am IST, 13 Nov · Microsoft says it has validated a different way of running server health checks, bringing some servers back online. It says it has found no recent change linked to the start of the problem; its investigation points to a component that processes server health checks.

item.title: Outlook outage: Restored servers fail again
item.description: ≈ 4:30 am IST, 13 Nov · Microsoft says servers it returned to service can become unresponsive again once they receive traffic. It pauses deployments, limits some traffic to the affected systems and keeps restarting servers.

item.title: Outlook outage: No sustained recovery yet; not a cyber attack
item.description: ≈ 10 am IST, 13 Nov · As Europe wakes up, the outage is still widespread. Microsoft says its fixes are bringing partial recovery but not a sustained one, and a Microsoft executive says it was not caused by a cyber attack. No time is given for a full fix.

item.title: Outlook outage: 'Encouraging recovery progress'
item.description: ≈ 5:40 pm IST, 13 Nov · Microsoft says service availability and email delivery are improving across a growing share of affected systems, after restarting servers and redirecting traffic. Some users report regaining access.

item.title: Outlook outage: Microsoft: service restored
item.description: Evening, 13 Nov IST · Microsoft says its fixes have restored service health and functionality, and that email queues are approaching normal levels. It repeats there is no sign of a cyber attack.

item.title: Outlook outage: What caused it: early explanations
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Microsoft has traced the trouble to an overloaded process on affected servers that sets up secure connections, which caused them to fail health checks. The Verge's Tom Warren reports it is linked to an Azure network (VNET) configuration change, and Australia's Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke says Microsoft told him it was related to a software update. Microsoft has not confirmed a root cause and has promised a post-incident report.

item.title: US midterms: Where the count stands
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · As of 1:16 pm IST on 13 November, AP's count shows Democrats with 255 House seats won and Republicans with 169; 11 House seats are not yet counted as won for either party. In the Senate, Democrats have 55 seats including 2 who caucus with them, and Republicans 44; 1 seat is not yet counted for either. These numbers may change.

item.title: Inflation: October inflation hits 6.09%, above the RBI's limit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Retail inflation rises for a ninth month in a row to 6.09%, breaching the RBI's 6% upper limit for the first time since October 2024. Food inflation climbs to 8.94%, and rural inflation (6.63%) runs above urban (5.41%).

item.title: Budget 2027: Diesel support costs ₹14,000 crore a month, PM says
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · PM Modi says crude's jump from $70 to $122 a barrel called for a diesel increase of at least ₹50 a litre, but the government raised it by ₹7 and absorbed the rest. He puts the cost at ₹14,000 crore every month, a pressure on the deficit going into the Budget.

item.title: RBI rates: Inflation crosses 6% before the December meeting
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · October retail inflation comes in at 6.09%, above the RBI's tolerance band. It is the last inflation reading before the 2–4 Dec policy meeting, and economists are now talking about another hike.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · After a board meeting on Wednesday night, Nvidia says its co-founder has stepped down as chief executive. Chief financial officer Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis, and venture investor Harvey C. Jones becomes the company’s first board chair. The board is reported to be looking at outside candidates for the permanent role. Investigations by the FBI and Congress, and a shareholder class-action lawsuit, continue.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Shares fall 4% on the day he resigns
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Nvidia closes down about 4%, taking its fall from the 6 October record high to 30.5%, according to CNN. Bloomberg, citing Vanda Research, reports retail investors bought a record $111 million of Nvidia shares in the first 30 minutes of trading.

item.title: AI this week: Nonprofits sue to freeze frontier AI
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Four nonprofits, including Public Citizen, sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceXSI in San Francisco, asking a judge to stop them building or releasing more capable AI. They argue the risks break California's unfair competition law. The claims have not been tested in court, no freeze has been ordered, and the companies had not commented.

item.title: AI this week: TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in AI labs
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Chipmaker TSMC's board approves up to $1 billion of AI investments, split between OpenAI and Anthropic shares, Ars Technica reports, citing Reuters.

item.title: OpenAI: Sued, and TSMC invests
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · OpenAI is one of five AI companies named in a lawsuit asking a court to freeze advanced AI development. The same day, TSMC approves up to $1 bn of AI investments split between OpenAI and Anthropic, Reuters reports.

item.title: Anthropic: Named in AI freeze lawsuit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Four nonprofits ask a San Francisco court to stop Anthropic and four rivals from building more capable AI. No ruling has been made.

item.title: Google Gemini: AlphaGenome 2 and a lawsuit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2, a DNA model. Google is among five companies named in the AI freeze lawsuit.

item.title: Meta AI: Named in AI freeze lawsuit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Meta is one of five companies nonprofits are asking a court to stop from building more capable AI.

item.title: xAI & Grok: Named in AI freeze lawsuit
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · xAI, now SpaceX's AI arm (named in court papers as SpaceXSI), is one of five companies sued by nonprofits seeking to halt more capable AI.

item.title: China's AI labs: ByteDance: frontier parity by 2029–30
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · ByteDance plans a Meta Muse-style assistant within weeks, and co-founder Zhang Yiming tells staff catching OpenAI and Anthropic will not happen before 2029 or 2030, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: India AI rules: Push for Indian AI in critical sectors
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · The government is likely to push departments in sectors such as defence and aerospace to use Indian-built AI models and agents, MediaNama reports. It notes that MeitY has released only a fraction of the IndiaAI Mission's ₹10,371.92 crore budget.
